race.description: Barbagallo Norms Daughter Classic Ms Pace (G2)
race.comment: DELIGHTFUL PEG NZ (3) is a mare in form and added to a string of wins and placings when she led and kept going to score by 2m last week. That was her sixth win in eight attempts at this circuit and distance and she should be able to go forward again from this barrier so is the one to beat. PENNY BLACK NZ (7) came from one spot wider than this to find winning form at this circuit and distance last week. If things go her was she is good enough to threaten. COPY CAT QUEEN (11) draws on the back row and may need a touch of luck but she is hard to knock having won twice in a row at this circuit and distance before coming from the outside barrier to get within 2m of Delightful Peg last week. FAKENIT (2) has been coming from wide barriers so the better draw gives her the chance to find her best form. AARDIEBYTHESEASIDE NZ (5) is an accomplished mare who strikes at 50 per cent when fresh so is worth including.
